import nanosurf
import time

#load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()  # or .C3000() or .CX(), or .CoreAFM()
application = spm.application
scan = application.Scan

# Start scan
# scan.StartFrameDown() #Scanning from up to down or top to bottom
scan.StartFrameUp() #Scanning from down to up or bottom to top

#scan.stop() #stop sacn
scanning = scan.IsScanning # Check if scanning
while scanning:
        print("Scanning in progress... Remaining lines:",(scan.Lines-scan.Currentline))
        time.sleep(3)
        scanning = scan.IsScanning
print("Scanning finished")
del spm

import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get access to different components
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set scan parameters for 10x10 µm² area
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame
scan.Scantime = 0.4  # time per line in seconds (51.33s / 128 lines ≈ 0.4s)

print("AFM configured with:")
print(f"Image size: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6} x {scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm²")
print(f"Points per line: {scan.Points}")
print(f"Lines per frame: {scan.Lines}")
print(f"Time per line: {scan.Scantime} s")
print(f"Estimated time per scan: {scan.Scantime * scan.Lines} s")

# Perform first scan
print("\n=== Starting Scan 1 ===")
scan.StartFrameUp()
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    print(f"Scan 1 in progress... Remaining lines: {scan.Lines - scan.Currentline}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning
print("Scan 1 finished")
time.sleep(2)

# Perform second scan
print("\n=== Starting Scan 2 ===")
scan.StartFrameUp()
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    print(f"Scan 2 in progress... Remaining lines: {scan.Lines - scan.Currentline}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning
print("Scan 2 finished")
time.sleep(2)

# Perform third scan
print("\n=== Starting Scan 3 ===")
scan.StartFrameUp()
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    print(f"Scan 3 in progress... Remaining lines: {scan.Lines - scan.Currentline}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning
print("Scan 3 finished")

print("\nAll three scans completed successfully!")
del spm

zcontrol.PGain = 100
zcontrol.IGain = 6000
zcontrol.DGain = 10

print("Configuration complete!")

print(f"Resolution: {scan.Points} x {scan.Lines}")
print(f"Time per line: {scan.Scantime} s")
print(f"Estimated time per scan: {scan.Scantime * scan.Lines} s")
